response.overview: Alison’s (Alison Rey) therapy sessions are going well and her therapist (Silvia Saige) believes she’s ready for the final step. Silvia offers to come to their home and tells Alison, “just introduce me as your friend and leave everything to me”. Silvia arrives and while Alison’s changing into something “different” a curious Ryan (Ryan McLane) asks Silvia how the two ladies met. When Alison returns wearing almost nothing, her husband puts his curiosity aside and the fun begins. Alison and Sylvia rock Ryan’s world leaving him to wonder how his wife learned to be such a sexy slut.
response.title: The Therapist 2 (Chapter 3)
